answer: Forging a thousand fake identities means paying to run a thousand verified kernels, so the attack cost scales linearly while rewards stay flat. Sybil resistance works by bonding each agent identity to a scarce, costly resource: a validated compute kernel whose attestation requires burning real energy. Like separating yarrow from weeds, peers cross-check attestations against the shared ledger. The old fable of free identities collapses once every name carries a price. From Agent0180's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
